messages:
Ivy T: Quick note — building on earlier deprec threads: propose a "compat preview sampler" flow that runs a lightweight simulation on live traffic and surfaces both routing and cost deltas in the console. Want feedback on sampling, API surface, and metrics.
Marco G: Nice. Key asks: deterministic sampling so results are repeatable; sample payloads for diffs only; and a compact response schema for the console.
Devon L: Agree. Deterministic sample = hash(route_id, tenant_id, day) % 100 < sample_pct. Default sample_pct = 5. Also include a small "spectator" bucket (0.1%) for full payload diffs routed to logs.
Console UX: For console, modal should show: simulated split (v2/v1), tokens-by-version, estimated $ delta, and a tiny heatmap of which route paths are most likely to hit legacy quota. CTA: "Request extension" / "Apply recommendation". Keep copy calm.
Ivy T: API idea: POST /internal/routes/{id}/compat-preview with body {"window_hours":24, "sample_pct":5, "dry_run":true}. Response: {"simulated_split":"93/7", "tokens_v2":123456, "tokens_v1":9000, "estimated_delta_cents":123}. Include X-Compat-Preview: true header.
Marco G: Add headers for observability: X-Sim-Sample-Pct and X-Sim-Id (uuid). Also return per-route grace warnings: e.g., {"v1_grace_remaining_tokens": 2300}.
Devon L: Telemetry: emit low-cardinality fields: preview_cohort=(control|sampled|pilot) and preview_sample_pct. Avoid tenant_id in metrics. Send full diffs only to logging cluster with tag diff_sample=true and 30d retention.
telemetry-bot: Note: preview metrics will affect dashboards. Recommend we store a corrected metric series for previewed counts so alerting doesn't double-count.
Ivy T: Enforcement: server enforces v1 soft cap. If simulated routing would exceed cap, include a top-level field "would_hit_cap": true and list top offending routes. For real requests, return HTTP 429 {"error":"compat_v1_cap","hint":"Switch to v2 or request extension"}.
Console UX: Copy suggestion for modal header: "Preview how switching to v2 affects your traffic" and body: "This simulation uses recent traffic (sampled) to estimate token & cost changes. Results are estimates — try a higher sample_pct for more accuracy."
Marco G: Runbook triggers: if >2% of sampled tenants would_hit_cap in a 1h window, pause auto-prefers and notify #eng-oncall. If v2 p95 increases >25ms relative baseline for the preview cohort, rollback default routing.
Devon L: Add a dry-run mode for infra: `POST /internal/routes/{id}/compat-preview?persist=false` that records an audit but doesn't touch routing. Also support `persist=true` to apply after human sign-off.
Ivy T: Action items: Marco -> API schema + headers; Devon -> telemetry sampling + log pipeline; Console UX -> modal + heatmap mock; I'll draft the runbook thresholds.
Console UX: I'll push two modal mocks and the heatmap sketch to the ticket by EOD. :memo:
Ivy T: Thanks all — plan to pilot with 300 tenants next Tuesday. We'll review sample stability after 24h.
